name: artisandispo-functions
description: Cloud Functions pour ArtisanSafe - Annulation automatique devis non payés

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:annulation: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions:annulerDevisNonPayes
scripts.deploy:virements: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions:processVirementRequests
